newsitem.title: FRANCE: Four ships loading wheat in Rouen, four more due.
newsitem.headline: Four ships loading wheat in Rouen, four more due.

text.p: Four ships are loading a total of 75,000 tonnes of wheat at Rouen, port officials said on Tuesday.
The wheat is for export to west Africa, Cuba, Egypt and Sudan, they said.
One ship is also loading 13,000 tonnes of barley destined for South Africa.
Four more ships were expected in port by March 26 to load around 38,000 tonnes of wheat. The destination was not specified.
One ship is also due in Rouen by March 26 to load 3,600 tonnes of barley for export to an unspecified destination.
